player_prompt.intro:
I nih Player {player_id} niin Checkers khel a, {color} niin khel mek che u.
Move na siam te chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank] hmang rawh, e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Diagonally forward ah 1 chauh zelin move thei e.
  • Opponent piece jump vekin capture thei e.
  • Piece pakhat opposite end thleng chuan King ah siam thei e.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move format pangai awm lo. [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3] hmang rawh.
